preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of provinces N must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of destroyed roads M must be between 0 and the minimum of the total possible roads and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: All destroyed roads must connect valid provinces and must not connect a province to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of possible ways to deploy the senas as a string.
